modules.name: Authentication
modules.description: User login, registration, and password management

scenarios.title: User Login with Valid Credentials
scenarios.description: Verify that a user can successfully log in with valid username and password
scenarios.preconditions: User account exists and is active
scenarios.expectedOutcome: User is successfully logged in and redirected to dashboard

testCases.title: Login with valid credentials
testCases.description: Verify successful login with correct username and password
testCases.preConditions: User exists with email test@example.com and password Password123!
testCases.postConditions: User is logged in and on dashboard page

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
steps.expectedResult: Login form is displayed with email and password fields

steps.description: Enter valid email address in the email field
steps.expectedResult: Email is accepted and displayed in the field

steps.description: Enter valid password in the password field
steps.expectedResult: Password is masked and displayed as dots

steps.description: Click the "Sign In" button
steps.expectedResult: User is redirected to the dashboard page

steps.description: Verify the welcome message displays user name
steps.expectedResult: Welcome message shows "Welcome, [User Name]"

testCases.title: User Login with Valid Credentials - Negative Flow: Mandatory Field & Missing Input Validation
testCases.description: Ensure the system prevents submission and enforces validation when required inputs are omitted.
testCases.preConditions: User account exists and is active
testCases.postConditions: No invalid or partial transaction records are committed to the system.

steps.description: Open the entry form for "User Login with Valid Credentials".
steps.expectedResult: Form loads with mandatory indicators (asterisks or highlights) visible.

steps.description: Leave mandatory fields blank and trigger the submit/save action.
steps.expectedResult: Submission is rejected with field-level inline error messages displayed.

steps.description: Verify that form state retains focus on the first invalid field and no server record is generated.
steps.expectedResult: System prevents persistence and maintains clean state.

testCases.title: User Login with Valid Credentials - Access Control & Role-Based Permissions
testCases.description: Verify that unauthorized or read-only users cannot perform or modify "User Login with Valid Credentials".
testCases.preConditions: User logged in with restricted / non-privileged role.
testCases.postConditions: Restricted operations remain protected and unauthorized actions are blocked.

steps.description: Attempt to access the action controls for "User Login with Valid Credentials" using a restricted account.
steps.expectedResult: Action buttons are disabled or hidden based on RBAC rules.

steps.description: Attempt direct URL or API execution for the protected endpoint.
steps.expectedResult: Server returns HTTP 403 Forbidden with access denial log recorded.

testCases.title: User Login with Valid Credentials - Positive / Standard Workflow Verification
testCases.description: Validate end-to-end execution of "User Login with Valid Credentials" under standard operational conditions.
testCases.preConditions: User account exists and is active
testCases.postConditions: User is successfully logged in and redirected to dashboard

steps.description: Access the Authentication module within the application dashboard.
steps.expectedResult: Module interface loads successfully with all navigation tabs and action controls accessible.

steps.description: Verify that system preconditions are active: "User account exists and is active".
steps.expectedResult: Initial state confirms required records, configurations, or privileges are available.

steps.description: Initiate the transaction for "User Login with Valid Credentials" and input all valid mandatory parameters.
steps.expectedResult: All form inputs accept data without formatting errors or inline validation flags.

steps.description: Submit and execute the action, observing client-side request dispatch.
steps.expectedResult: System shows progress/processing indicator and submits payload without timeout.

steps.description: Confirm primary business outcome: "User is successfully logged in and redirected to dashboard".
steps.expectedResult: Success notification appears and record status updates to confirmed/active.

steps.description: Verify system audit log and persisted record consistency in database/storage.
steps.expectedResult: Activity log documents the event with timestamp, user ID, and unchanged attributes.

testCases.title: User Login with Valid Credentials - Boundary & Limit Verification
testCases.description: Test system handling of boundary characters, maximum field lengths, and extreme parameter values.
testCases.preConditions: User account exists and is active
testCases.postConditions: Inputs exceeding limits are either gracefully truncated or rejected with clear feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to "User Login with Valid Credentials" entry screen and enter inputs with maximum allowed boundary lengths.
steps.expectedResult: System enforces maximum length constraints or indicators without crashing.

steps.description: Enter special characters, unicode strings, and whitespace variations in descriptive fields.
steps.expectedResult: System handles special formatting properly with sanitization.

steps.description: Execute submission and verify stored string representation.
steps.expectedResult: Data is stored accurately without injection errors or truncation corruption.

testCases.title: User Login with Valid Credentials - Error Recovery & Concurrency Handling
testCases.description: Verify system resiliency when double-submitting or facing transient network interruptions.
testCases.preConditions: User account exists and is active
testCases.postConditions: Idempotency is maintained; no duplicate entries created.

steps.description: Trigger the submission action for "User Login with Valid Credentials" rapidly twice (double click test).
steps.expectedResult: System disables the submit button on first click to prevent duplicate submissions.

steps.description: Verify database records for duplicate entries.
steps.expectedResult: Exactly one transaction is created and confirmed.

scenarios.title: Password Reset via Email
scenarios.description: Verify that a user can request and complete a password reset
scenarios.preconditions: User has a verified email address
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Password reset email is sent and user can reset password

scenarios.title: Add Items to Shopping Cart
scenarios.description: Verify that users can add products to their shopping cart
scenarios.preconditions: User is logged in, products are available
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Items are added to cart with correct quantity and price

name: Oracle Argus Safety
description: Pharmacovigilance safety database for adverse event reporting

modules.name: Case Intake & Data Entry
modules.description: Spontaneous reports, literature cases, study cases intake

scenarios.title: Create Spontaneous Adverse Event Case
scenarios.description: Verify creation of a new spontaneous AE case with complete patient and event details
scenarios.preconditions: User has Case Processor role; Argus Safety is accessible
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Case is successfully created with unique case ID and all data is saved correctly

scenarios.title: Create Literature Case with Reference
scenarios.description: Verify creation of a literature case with journal reference and author details
scenarios.preconditions: User has Case Processor role; Literature source is identified
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Literature case created with proper reference linking and PubMed ID validation

scenarios.title: Import Case from E2B Gateway
scenarios.description: Verify successful import of ICH E2B R3 case from regulatory gateway
scenarios.preconditions: E2B gateway is configured; XML message is available
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Case is imported with all E2B fields mapped correctly

scenarios.title: Validate Duplicate Case Detection
scenarios.description: Verify system identifies potential duplicate cases during intake
scenarios.preconditions: Similar case already exists in database
scenarios.expectedOutcome: System displays potential duplicates with match score for reviewer assessment

scenarios.title: Enter Product Information with Dosage
scenarios.description: Verify entry of suspect and concomitant products with dosage regimen
scenarios.preconditions: Case is created; Product dictionary is loaded
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Products are coded with WHODrug and dosage is captured correctly

scenarios.title: Code Adverse Events with MedDRA
scenarios.description: Verify coding of verbatim terms to MedDRA LLT, PT, and SOC levels
scenarios.preconditions: Case has adverse event terms entered; MedDRA dictionary is loaded
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Verbatims are coded to appropriate MedDRA levels with auto-coding suggestions

scenarios.title: Enter Medical History and Risk Factors
scenarios.description: Verify capture of patient medical history and relevant risk factors
scenarios.preconditions: Case is in data entry mode
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Medical history is recorded with onset dates and relationship to AE

modules.name: Blinded & Unblinded Processing
modules.description: Blind maintenance, unblinding workflows, treatment exposure

scenarios.title: Create Blinded Case for Clinical Trial AE
scenarios.description: Verify creation of blinded case where treatment allocation is hidden
scenarios.preconditions: User has Blinded Case Processor role; Study is configured for blind maintenance
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Case is created with masked treatment information; blind is maintained in database

testCases.title: TC-001: Create new blinded case with masked treatment allocation
testCases.description: Verify that a user with Blinded Case Processor role can create a case where treatment information is hidden
testCases.preConditions:
1. User is logged in with Blinded Case Processor role
2. Study is configured for blind maintenance in Argus
3. Patient meets eligibility for AE reporting
testCases.postConditions: Case is saved with blinded status; Treatment field shows "BLINDED" or similar mask

steps.description: Navigate to Case Intake module and click "Create New Case"
steps.expectedResult: New case form opens with all required fields displayed

steps.description: Select study type as "Clinical Trial" and choose the blinded study from dropdown
steps.expectedResult: Study is selected; system recognizes it as blinded study

steps.description: Enter patient demographics (age, sex, weight, country)
steps.expectedResult: Patient information is saved; no validation errors

steps.description: Enter adverse event verbatim term and onset date
steps.expectedResult: AE term is captured; MedDRA coding suggestion appears

steps.description: In Product section, observe the treatment allocation field
steps.expectedResult: Treatment shows as "BLINDED" or "MASKED"; actual drug name is hidden

steps.description: Enter dosage regimen and indication (if known without unblinding)
steps.expectedResult: Dosage can be entered as "As per study protocol" or similar

steps.description: Complete remaining case sections (concomitant meds, medical history)
steps.expectedResult: All sections are accessible and save correctly

steps.description: Save the case and note the case ID
steps.expectedResult: Case is saved successfully with unique Argus case ID

steps.description: Verify case appears in case list with "Blinded" indicator
steps.expectedResult: Case displays with blind icon or status indicator

steps.description: Log in as Unblinded user and open the same case
steps.expectedResult: Unblinded user sees actual treatment name and full allocation details

scenarios.title: Process Unblinded Case from Open Label Study
scenarios.description: Verify processing of unblinded case with known treatment allocation
scenarios.preconditions: User has appropriate role; Study is open label or unblinded
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Case displays full treatment information including drug name and dose

testCases.title: TC-002: Process unblinded case with full treatment visibility
testCases.description: Verify that unblinded cases display complete treatment information
testCases.preConditions:
1. User has Unblinded Processor or Standard role
2. Study is open-label or post-unblinding
3. Treatment allocation is known
testCases.postConditions: Case displays full treatment details including drug name, dose, and frequency

steps.description: Navigate to existing unblinded case or create new case from open-label study
steps.expectedResult: Case opens successfully

steps.description: Navigate to Product Information section
steps.expectedResult: Product section displays with all fields visible

steps.description: Verify suspect product shows actual drug name (not masked)
steps.expectedResult: Drug name is fully visible (e.g., "Drug X 100mg")

steps.description: Verify treatment arm/group is displayed if applicable
steps.expectedResult: Treatment arm shows (e.g., "Treatment A", "Placebo", or actual name)

steps.description: Check case header or summary for blind status indicator
steps.expectedResult: Case shows "Unblinded" status or no blind indicator

steps.description: Verify ability to print/export case with full treatment details
steps.expectedResult: Exported case includes all treatment information

scenarios.title: Emergency Unblinding Request Workflow
scenarios.description: Verify emergency unblinding process with proper authorization and documentation
scenarios.preconditions: Blinded case exists; Emergency unblinding request is received
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Unblinding is performed with audit trail; notification sent to stakeholders; SAE timeline triggered

testCases.title: TC-003: Emergency unblinding with proper authorization workflow
testCases.description: Verify emergency unblinding process maintains compliance and audit trail
testCases.preConditions:
1. Blinded SAE case exists
2. Investigator requests emergency unblinding
3. User has unblinding authorization
testCases.postConditions: Case is unblinded with complete audit trail; SAE reporting timeline initiated

steps.description: Open blinded case requiring emergency unblinding
steps.expectedResult: Case opens in blinded view

steps.description: Click "Request Unblinding" or similar action button
steps.expectedResult: Unblinding request form opens

steps.description: Select reason for unblinding (e.g., "Serious AE requiring treatment knowledge")
steps.expectedResult: Reason is captured in unblinding request

steps.description: Enter requester details (Investigator name, contact information)
steps.expectedResult: Requester information is saved

steps.description: Obtain required authorization (electronic signature or approval workflow)
steps.expectedResult: Authorization is recorded with timestamp and approver ID

steps.description: Confirm unblinding action
steps.expectedResult: System displays confirmation dialog with warning about blind break

steps.description: Complete unblinding; observe treatment allocation is now visible
steps.expectedResult: Treatment name and details are displayed; blind is broken

steps.description: Verify audit trail entry for unblinding event
steps.expectedResult: Audit trail shows who, when, why, and authorization for unblinding

steps.description: Check if SAE reporting timeline is triggered (if applicable)
steps.expectedResult: System flags case for expedited reporting with due date calculated

steps.description: Verify notification is sent to relevant parties (Sponsor, Monitor, PV)
steps.expectedResult: Notifications logged in system; recipients recorded

scenarios.title: Unblinding via IVRS/IWRS Integration
scenarios.description: Verify unblinding data receipt from interactive voice/web response system
scenarios.preconditions: IVRS/IWRS integration is configured; Blinded case exists
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Treatment allocation is received and updated in Argus with timestamp

scenarios.title: Blind Maintenance During Database Lock
scenarios.description: Verify blind integrity is maintained during clinical database lock
scenarios.preconditions: Blinded cases exist; Database lock is initiated
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Blind remains intact; no unauthorized unblinding occurs

scenarios.title: Compare Blinded vs Unblinded Case Views
scenarios.description: Verify different data visibility between blinded and unblinded user roles
scenarios.preconditions: Same case accessible to both blinded and unblinded users
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Blinded user sees masked treatment; unblinded user sees full details

scenarios.title: Generate Blinded Safety Report
scenarios.description: Verify generation of safety report with treatment groups masked
scenarios.preconditions: Blinded cases exist; Report template is configured for blinded output
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Report shows Treatment A/B or placebo without revealing actual allocation

testCases.title: TC-004: Generate blinded safety report with masked treatment groups
testCases.description: Verify that safety reports for blinded studies mask treatment allocation
testCases.preConditions:
1. Multiple blinded cases exist in study
2. User has Blinded Reporter role
3. Report template is configured for blinded output
testCases.postConditions: Report is generated with Treatment A/B or similar masking; no actual drug names revealed

steps.description: Navigate to Reports module and select "Safety Report - Blinded"
steps.expectedResult: Report configuration screen opens

steps.description: Select study and date range for report
steps.expectedResult: Parameters are accepted; case count is displayed

steps.description: Verify "Blinded" option is selected (treatment masking)
steps.expectedResult: Blinded checkbox is selected or enforced by user role

steps.description: Select report sections (Case listings, AE summary, SAE tabulation)
steps.expectedResult: Selected sections are configured

steps.description: Click "Generate Report" or "Preview"
steps.expectedResult: Report generation begins; progress indicator shows

steps.description: Review generated report (PDF or Excel)
steps.expectedResult: Report opens with all treatment groups masked

steps.description: Verify treatment columns show "Treatment A", "Treatment B", "Placebo" etc.
steps.expectedResult: No actual drug names appear in any section of the report

steps.description: Verify case listings do not reveal treatment allocation
steps.expectedResult: Individual cases show masked treatment in listings

steps.description: Attempt to export or print the report
steps.expectedResult: Exported file maintains blinding; no hidden data leakage

steps.description: Compare with unblinded report (if user has both roles)
steps.expectedResult: Unblinded report shows actual treatment names; blinded does not

scenarios.title: Generate Unblinded Safety Report for DMC
scenarios.description: Verify generation of unblinded report for Data Monitoring Committee
scenarios.preconditions: User has DMC unblinded role; Unblinded cases or unblinded data available
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Report displays actual treatment names and comparative safety data

scenarios.title: Re-blind Case After Unblinding
scenarios.description: Verify ability to re-blind a case when appropriate (system reset)
scenarios.preconditions: Case was previously unblinded; Re-blinding is authorized
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Treatment information is masked again; audit trail preserves unblinding history

modules.name: Regulatory Reporting
modules.description: FDA FAERS, EudraVigilance, WHO VigiBase submissions

scenarios.title: Generate FDA 3517A Form for US Cases
scenarios.description: Verify generation of FDA MedWatch 3517A form for domestic reporting
scenarios.preconditions: Case is US origin and meets FDA reporting criteria
scenarios.expectedOutcome: 3517A form is populated correctly and ready for submission

scenarios.title: Submit E2B R3 to FDA FAERS Gateway
scenarios.description: Verify electronic submission of ICH E2B R3 message to FDA FAERS
scenarios.preconditions: Case is ready for FDA submission; Gateway credentials configured
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Message transmitted successfully; ACK received and stored in case

scenarios.title: Submit to EudraVigilance (EV)
scenarios.description: Verify submission of E2B R3 message to EU EudraVigilance database
scenarios.preconditions: Case is reportable to EU; EV gateway is configured
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Message transmitted; EV report number received and stored

scenarios.title: Calculate Regulatory Reporting Timelines
scenarios.description: Verify automatic calculation of 7-day/15-day reporting deadlines
scenarios.preconditions: Case has receipt date and seriousness criteria
scenarios.expectedOutcome: System calculates due date based on regulation; alerts for approaching deadlines

scenarios.title: Generate CIOMS Form for International Cases
scenarios.description: Verify generation of CIOMS I/II form for non-US/international reporting
scenarios.preconditions: Case is from outside US; CIOMS reporting applies
scenarios.expectedOutcome: CIOMS form is populated with all required fields

scenarios.title: Submit to WHO VigiBase
scenarios.description: Verify submission of case to WHO global safety database
scenarios.preconditions: Country requires VigiBase reporting; Gateway configured
scenarios.expectedOutcome: E2B message transmitted; VigiBase ID received

scenarios.title: Handle Reporting to Multiple Health Authorities
scenarios.description: Verify simultaneous reporting to FDA, EV, and other authorities
scenarios.preconditions: Case is reportable to multiple regions
scenarios.expectedOutcome: All required submissions are generated with region-specific formatting

scenarios.title: Amend Previously Submitted Report
scenarios.description: Verify submission of follow-up/amendment to regulatory authority
scenarios.preconditions: Initial report was submitted; New information received
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Follow-up submission links to initial report with updated data

modules.name: Signal Detection & Analytics
modules.description: Signal management, trend analysis, aggregate reporting

scenarios.title: Run Disproportionality Analysis
scenarios.description: Verify execution of statistical signal detection (PRR, ROR, EBGM)
scenarios.preconditions: Sufficient case volume exists; Signal detection module is licensed
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Statistical measures calculated; potential signals identified above threshold

scenarios.title: Review and Validate Signal
scenarios.description: Verify signal review workflow with clinical assessment
scenarios.preconditions: Signal was detected; Signal Review Team assigned
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Signal is validated, prioritized, and recommendation documented

scenarios.title: Generate Line Listing for Product-AE Combination
scenarios.description: Verify extraction of all cases for specific product and event
scenarios.preconditions: Cases exist for the product-AE combination
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Line listing includes all relevant fields with proper filtering

scenarios.title: Create Aggregate Report (PSUR/DSUR)
scenarios.description: Verify generation of periodic safety update reports
scenarios.preconditions: Reporting period is defined; Data cutoff applied
scenarios.expectedOutcome: PSUR/DSUR sections populated with case data, narratives, and exposure

scenarios.title: Generate PADER Report for FDA
scenarios.description: Verify creation of Periodic Adverse Drug Experience Report
scenarios.preconditions: NDA/BLA product with FDA reporting requirement
scenarios.expectedOutcome: PADER sections include summary tabulations, narratives, and updates

scenarios.title: Trend Analysis for Adverse Events
scenarios.description: Verify visualization of AE trends over time
scenarios.preconditions: Historical case data exists
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Charts display AE frequency trends with filtering options

scenarios.title: Perform Medical Review of AE Case
scenarios.description: Verify medical reviewer can evaluate case completeness and accuracy
scenarios.preconditions: Case is in Medical Review status; User has Medical Reviewer role
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Medical reviewer can approve, reject, or request additional information

scenarios.title: Assess Causality for Suspect Product
scenarios.description: Verify causality assessment using WHO or company-specific algorithm
scenarios.preconditions: Case has suspect product; User has causality assessment rights
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Causality is assessed (Certain/Probable/Possible/Unlikely) with narrative justification

scenarios.title: Determine Seriousness Criteria
scenarios.description: Verify assessment of seriousness criteria (death, hospitalization, etc.)

scenarios.description: Verify creation of comprehensive medical narrative for serious cases

scenarios.title: Assign Expectedness (Labeling)
scenarios.description: Verify determination of expectedness against product labeling/CCDS
scenarios.preconditions: Case has suspect product; CCDS is maintained in system

scenarios.title: Follow-up Request for Additional Information
scenarios.description: Verify generation of follow-up request to reporter for missing information
scenarios.preconditions: Case has missing critical information
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Follow-up letter is generated and tracked for response

scenarios.title: Pregnancy Exposure Assessment
scenarios.description: Verify assessment of pregnancy exposure case with maternal/paternal exposure
scenarios.preconditions: Case involves pregnancy exposure during treatment
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Pregnancy details captured including outcome and infant health
